{{Recipe}}

This '''Moroccan salad''' is something that is easy to throw together, refreshing to eat, and good-looking. 

==Ingredients==
* 3 large, ripe [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* 1 green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]]
* 1 smallish [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* 1 handful of [[Cookbook:Cilantro|fresh coriander]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] ground [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|Black pepper]] to taste
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]] or [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
==Procedure==
#Cut the tomatoes, pepper and onion into small [[Cookbook:Dice|dice]].
#Add the fresh coriander, cumin, salt, pepper, and vinegar.
#Put it all into a container, put the lid on tightly, and give it a good shake to combine everything.
#Let rest for 30 minutes to allow the flavours to mingle before serving.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* You can peel the tomatoes if you wish.
